title: Amber Projection Manifest
description: A rebuildable read-only projection manifest. Projections (Governance Graph, Governed Knowledge Base, Visualization Workbench) are derived from canonical Amber artifacts and are never canonical authority. See ADR-0012 amendment (projection versioning), ADR-0019 D5, and the distributed-governance baseline.

projectionId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this projection instance.

projectionType.description: Projection kind. Reserved by ADR-0012 amendment.

projectionVersion.description: Projection schema version. Bump on breaking output-shape changes.

rebuildCheckpoint.description: Deterministic anchor identifying the canonical state this projection was built from.

sourceHash.description: Hash of the canonical artifacts this projection was built from.

outputHash.description: Hash of the projection output, for drift detection.

rebuiltAt.description: When the projection was last rebuilt.
